column1: # Known deviations of the implementations under test, verified by hand.
# A failing result matching client, peer and scenario (fnmatch patterns) is
# reported as "known-difference" with the reason; it still appears in every
# report. Remove a line when the deviation is fixed upstream.

column4: KNXUltimate 6.3.1 announces <local IP>:3671 in its DESCRIPTION_REQUEST HPAI while it listens on an ephemeral port (src/KNXClient.ts sendDescriptionRequestMessage: new HPAI(localIPAddress), default port 3671); servers that answer to the HPAI, as the standard requires, answer a port nobody listens on

calimero-server 3.0-M1 stops answering for about 10 s after a 3-octet datagram: its log shows the control endpoint coming up again ("control endpoint ... is up and running"); description requests meanwhile are logged as "unknown service type 0x203 - ignored"
calimero-server 3.0-M1 stops answering for about 10 s after a CONNECT_REQUEST whose CRI has length 0, as after a truncated header

UNEXPLAINED (open): fails in every full matrix run (local and CI, amd64) but passes in isolation with both xknx and go-knx observing (2026-10-29); sequence-dependent between knxd's tunnel client and calimero-server, under investigation
UNEXPLAINED (open): fails in every full matrix run right after calimero-server's outages, passed in an earlier run; under investigation
